rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for inventive ideas and clever solutions.

example.english: This design shows a lot of ingenuity, turning a small room into something so practical.
example.traditional: 呢個設計好有創意，將細房間變到咁實用。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 cit3 gai3 hou2 jau5 cong3 ji3 zoeng1 sai3 fong4 gaan1 bin3 dou3 gam3 sat6 jung6

rows.note: Use this colloquial word when focusing on someone’s ability to come up with clever ideas or approaches.

example.english: Your ingenuity is amazing—you can even turn a broken fan into an extractor.
example.traditional: 你真係多諗頭，連壞咗嘅風扇都可以整成抽氣機。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 do1 nam2 tau4 lin4 waai6 zo2 ge3 fung1 sin3 dou1 ho2 ji5 zing2 sing4 cau1 hei3 gei1

rows.note: Use this when the ingenuity is shown by careful, thoughtful design or effort rather than by originality alone.

example.english: You can see the ingenuity you put into the gift.
example.traditional: 份禮物睇得出你落咗好多心思。
example.jyutping: fan2 lai5 mat6 tai2 dak1 ceot1 nei5 lok6 zo2 hou2 do1 sam1 si1
